login.subtitle: Enter your API bearer token to continue.

vmlist.title: Virtual Machines
vmlist.empty: No VMs running. Create one to get started.

createModal.title: Create VM
createModal.profileHint: Sets the LLM model. Edit profiles in Settings.
createModal.tokenWarnPre: This agent token is shown only once and is
createModal.tokenWarnPost: . Copy it now if you need to call the agent directly.

vmdetail.snapshotsHint: Capture this VM's memory + disk as a restorable snapshot.

taskpanel.title: Conversation
taskpanel.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a newline
taskpanel.resumingNote: Resuming a previous conversation ({turns} turns) — the agent keeps its context; earlier messages aren't re-shown here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.note: Each profile selects a provider and model. Provider choices are limited to those with an API key in the global keychain (configs/goose-secrets.yaml). Changes apply to the next Create VM, not to running VMs.
settings.saved: Profile {name} saved — new VMs will use it.
settings.noProviders: No providers configured. Add an API key (e.g. GROQ_API_KEY) to configs/goose-secrets.yaml, then reload.

profileModal.title: New profile
profileModal.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'. Used as the profile id.
profileModal.modelHint: Pick a suggested model or type any model id the provider supports.
profileModal.sizingHint: vCPUs (1–8) and memory (256–16384 MiB) to allocate to VMs created from this profile.
profileModal.noProviders: No providers have an API key configured. Add one to configs/goose-secrets.yaml first.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.empty: No snapshots yet. Create one from a VM's detail page.
snapshots.deleteConfirm: Delete snapshot {id}? This cannot be undone.
snapshots.deleteWarnRestored: If a running VM was restored from this snapshot, it will not survive a daemon restart after deletion.

restoreModal.title: Restore snapshot
restoreModal.confirmIntro: Restore snapshot {id} into a new VM.
restoreModal.warnSourceStopped: The source VM must be stopped — restore is refused while it is still running.
restoreModal.warnNewVm: This creates a new VM (new ID and IP) that reuses the original agent token.
restoreModal.warnResetOnRestart: Restored VMs reset to their snapshot state on daemon restart.
restoreModal.tokenWarnPre: This is the original agent token, shown once and
restoreModal.tokenWarnPost: . Copy it now if you need to call the agent directly.

snapshotModal.title: Create snapshot
snapshotModal.typeHint: Auto picks full if no prior full snapshot exists, otherwise diff.
snapshotModal.stopAfterHint: Destroys the source VM once the snapshot is taken.

orchestration.title: Agent Groups
orchestration.empty: No agent groups yet. Create one to run a multi-agent flock.

createFlockModal.title: Create Agent Group
createFlockModal.taskPlaceholder: What should this group work on?
createFlockModal.rolesHint: One VM is spawned per role. Roles map to profiles (sizing, model, system prompt).
createFlockModal.rolesRequired: At least one role is required
createFlockModal.tokensIntro: One agent token per agent — shown once and not stored server-side.
createFlockModal.tokenWarnPre: These agent tokens are shown only once and are
createFlockModal.tokenWarnPost: . Copy any you need to call an agent directly.

flockDetail.noAgents: No agents. Add one to populate this group.
flockDetail.removeConfirm: Remove agent {id}? Its VM is destroyed.
flockDetail.restartConfirm: Restart agent {id}? Its VM is recreated; the agent token is preserved.
flockDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete agent group {id}? All member VMs are destroyed. This is irreversible.
flockDetail.deleteWarn: Every member VM is torn down. This cannot be undone.

addAgentModal.title: Add agent
addAgentModal.roleHint: Spawns one VM for this role and joins it to the group.
addAgentModal.tokenWarnPre: This agent token is shown only once and is
addAgentModal.tokenWarnPost: . Copy it now if you need to call the agent directly.

changeRoleModal.title: Change agent role
changeRoleModal.warn: The agent's VM is recreated under the new role (its sizing and system prompt change). The agent ID and token are preserved.

broadcastModal.title: Broadcast
broadcastModal.intro: Send one prompt to every agent in the group. Each runs it as a task; busy agents are skipped.

activityFeed.title: Activity Feed
activityFeed.composerBody: Post a message to the feed…
